[图标] Python JavaScript Java Go REST from google import genai import base64 client = genai.Client() uploaded_file = client.files.upload(file="path/to/sample.mp3") interaction = client.interactions.create( model="gemini-3.8-flash", input=[ {"type": "text", "text": "Describe this audio clip"}, { "type": "audio", "uri": uploaded_file.uri, "mime_type": uploaded_file.mime_type } ] ) print(interaction.output_text) Overview [图标] Gemini can analyze and understand audio input and generate text responses, enabling use cases like: Describe, summarize, or answer questions about audio content Transcription and translation (speech to text) Speaker diarization (identifying different speakers) Emotion detection in speech and music Analyzing specific segments with timestamps For real-time voice and video interactions, see the Live API. For dedicated speech to text models with support for real-time transcription, use the Google Cloud Speech-to-Text API. Transcribe speech to text [图标] This example shows how to transcribe, translate, and summarize speech with timestamps, speaker diarization, and emotion detection using structured outputs. [图标] Python JavaScript Java Go REST [undefined] Input audio [图标] You can provide audio data in the following ways: Upload an audio file before making a request. Pass inline audio data with the request. Upload an audio file [图标] Use the Files API for files larger than 20 MB. [图标] Python JavaScript Java Go REST Pass audio data inline [图标] For small audio files under 20MB total request size: [图标] Python JavaScript Java Go REST Notes on inline audio data: Maximum request size is 20 MB total (including prompts and all files) For reuse, upload the file instead Get a transcript [图标] To get a transcript, ask for it in the prompt: [图标] Python JavaScript Java Go Refer to timestamps [图标] Use MM:SS format to reference specific sections: [图标] Python JavaScript Java Go Count tokens [图标] Count tokens in an audio file: [图标] Python JavaScript Java Go Supported audio formats [图标] Gemini supports the following audio format MIME types: WAV - audio/wav MP3 - audio/mp3 AIFF - audio/aiff AAC - audio/aac OGG - audio/ogg FLAC - audio/flac MPEG - audio/mpeg M4A - audio/m4a L16 - audio/l16 Opus - audio/opus ALAW - audio/alaw MULAW - audio/mulaw WebM - audio/webm For the complete list of supported MIME types and parameter schemas, see the Interactions API reference. Technical details about audio [图标] Tokens: 32 tokens per second of audio (1 minute = 1,920 tokens) Non-speech: Gemini understands non-speech sounds (birdsong, sirens, etc.) Max length: 9.5 hours of audio per prompt Resolution: Downsampled to 16 Kbps Channels: Multi-channel audio combined to single channel What's next [图标] Files API: Upload and manage audio files System instructions: Customize model behavior Structured output: Get transcription results in JSON format
